name: How Houston Neighborhoods Compare for Renters
meta-description: Houston covers 670+ square miles. Compare Montrose, Midtown, the Heights, EaDo, and more by rent, transit, and lifestyle fit for your apartment search.
post-summary: The best neighborhoods in Houston for renters depend on where you work, what you prioritize on weekends, and how much of your budget goes to rent. Houston covers more than 670 square miles with no city zoning laws. This overview compares six Inner Loop neighborhoods and several outer-loop options by rent, transit, walkability, and lifestyle infrastructure.
